categories.name: Surge Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched via Surge, a multichain "Internet Capital Markets" platform designed for AI-native startups and revenue-generating businesses.

categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Tokenized Credit
categories.content: Tokens representing on-chain claims on debt instruments. Returns come from interest income and credit performance of the underlying borrowers, key risk dimensions are credit/default risk, seniority in the structure, and duration for fixed-rate instruments.

categories.name: Remora Markets Tokenized rStocks
categories.content: Remora Markets Tokenized rStocks are on-chain tokens that represent economic exposure to traditional stocks, with each token typically backed 1:1 by the underlying security held through a regulated custodian

categories.name: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities
categories.content: Tokenized Non-US Government Securities are RWAs that digitalize sovereign debt instruments and international money market funds outside of the United States such as German Bunds, UK Gilts, and sovereign-backed cash equivalents, to provide diversified international yield and institutional collateral on-chain.

categories.name: Etherfuse Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized sovereign debt (Stablebonds) issued by Etherfuse in compliance of CNBV regulation.

categories.name: Trading Card RWA Platform
categories.content: Trading Card RWA Platforms tokenize physical collectible cards (e.g., Pokémon, sports cards) on a blockchain. The physical cards are stored with a custodian or vault, and each blockchain token represents ownership of the real-world card. This enables features such as fractional ownership and global secondary trading.

categories.name: Commodities Meme
categories.content: Meme projects tied to commodities in traditional finance.

categories.name: Yoink.fun Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched through Yoink (https://yoinkai.fun/), an agentic launch and trading terminal on Robinhood Chain.

categories.name: Fractionalized NFT
categories.content: NFT that is being divided into smaller pieces which have more affordable pieces.

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Time.fun Ecosystem

categories.name: Hybrid Token Standards
categories.content: Hybrid Token Standards allow tokens to have characteristics of both fungible assets and non-fungible tokens.

categories.name: Duck-Themed

categories.name: Sun Pump Ecosystem

categories.name: Pump.fun Creator
categories.content: Pump.fun creator tokens are Solana-based memecoins tied to influencers, blending streaming culture with DeFi.
